statement: The 999 normal entrypoint carries the same product requirements as the primary flavour and reaches them through its own adapters. Where this tree has no carrier for a requirement, the requirement is declared absent with the unit that owes it and the upgrade path; it is never simulated, and a declaration that stops matching the tree fails the check.

observed_n999_head.method: read-only shallow clone, git cat-file and direct execution at .claude/skills/drama-song-ad-factory; no write, no install, no credential

absent.scripts/openclaw_adapter.py: this is the primary flavour's runtime wrapper; the 999 normal entrypoint is its own adapters/ tree

primary_flavour.why_vendored: The primary flavour's package manifest is not present at this base commit; it ships on S75-T29's branch. The package carries a byte-identical copy and pins its sha256 so the requirement set is read from data in this tree, not from a literal in package/999_adapter.py. A copy that stops matching the digest fails the check closed.

assembled_from.rule: The seam and its data are consumed as delivered by S75-T03 and are not re-derived here. package/999_adapter.py calls package_flavor_adapter.resolve('999') and refuses when the values below disagree with it.

requirement_additions.why_not_in_primary: The primary flavour folds approval ordering into its artifact_order and cast/world/script clauses. The 999 package names it as its own row because the ordering behaviour is what its music gate depends on, and a named row can be probed and reported on its own instead of hidden inside another clause.
requirement_additions.witness: scripts/core/story_first_contracts.py:APPROVAL_BINDS and check_stage; probe approval_ordering refuses a missing approval, admits a current binding and refuses a stale one.

requirement_additions.why_not_in_primary: The primary flavour does not carry paid-artifact compatibility as a package clause at this base. The 999 package names it because the 999 tree is the one that lacks scripts/core/compatibility.py, and an unmet requirement must be visible rather than absent from the set.
requirement_additions.witness: scripts/core/compatibility.py is absent in this tree and declared absent, owed by S75-T28; the row reports unmet, never met.

product_requirements.means: A stage whose required artifacts are absent is refused, and the refusal names every required artifact that is missing.
An empty cast fails closed; a one-line placeholder scene fails closed on dialogue and duration; character_bible.identity refuses an empty library, an empty episode setting and an empty identity.

absent.missing_capability: text-first identity saves without an image and a later image attachment does not duplicate the identity
absent.upgrade_path: Land S75-T15's notion_store.py under scripts/core/character_library/; this row then flips to carried and its carrier is probed.

absent.missing_capability: idempotent local-library migration with dry run and rollback
absent.upgrade_path: Land S75-T17's migration.py; this row then flips to carried and its carrier is probed.

product_requirements.means: Both present carriers are LOADED and exercised: the adapter refuses an offline connection and the sync protocol produces a stable payload digest and a deterministic operation id. The store and the migration module do not ship in this tree, and the row says so instead of reporting Notion met.
Eighteen unique style ids resolve one-to-one, and the original three keep their order and their descriptions.
Music is refused without a package approval and refused again when that approval's bound digests have moved; a current binding admits it.
Both flavours resolve against byte-identical shared core and differ in exactly the two declared package facts, so the 999 package reaches the same behaviour without forking it.

The 999 adapter and entrypoint carry no mutation path (no writable open, no unlink/rename/replace), the checker imports none of the held factory/approval modules, and every held file present is digested in the receipt. The accepted emergency fixes are read, never rewritten.
Running the 999 normal entrypoint loads every declared carrier into a fresh process, and every carrier is also in its static import closure, so a dynamic import cannot stand in for routing.

absent.missing_capability: legacy paid artifacts remain readable and compatibility-limited without automatic regeneration
absent.upgrade_path: Land S75-T28's compatibility.py plus its legacy map; this row then flips to carried and its carrier is probed.

product_requirements.means: No 999 carrier exists at this head for paid-artifact compatibility. The requirement is reported unmet with its owner, never reported met.

positive_controls.why: the entrypoint imports it directly; if the walk cannot see a direct edge, every unreachable verdict is meaningless
reached transitively from the control CLI (factory.py:3136); proves the walk follows imports inside functions and through packages, so a missing target is a finding rather than a broken walk

reachability.factory_not_claimed: scripts/core/intake_preflight/factory.py is one of the five HELD files (evidence/emergency-owner-handoff.json, owner UNKNOWN, state NOT_HANDED_OFF) and is out of this lane's lease. The reachability clause reports which declared carriers its own closure misses; it is not edited here and no exposure claim is made about it.

own_adapters.rule: The 999 normal entrypoint is this package's own adapter plus the 999 adapters/ tree. It never routes through the primary flavour's package adapter or its runtime wrapper.

layout_source.detected_by: skill root basename is 75-drama-song-ad-factory (the primary flavour's physical tree, where S75 source ships before the 999 landing)
layout_source.meaning: The primary front door exists here; the 999 package must not call it.

entrypoints.rule: Every advertised step carries a complete argv, a verified advertised_in citation and an observed exit code. The advertised check EXECUTES every step and compares the real exit code, so a fabricated record cannot satisfy it. A step that cannot execute at this head sits in fixture.excluded_steps and its claim is re-run on every check; a command that really runs fails the no-unsupported-commands clause.

not_claimed: No live 999 installation was performed and none was authorized; the 999 layout path (adapters/, .claude/skills/drama-song-ad-factory) does not exist in this repository, so the entrypoint is proven at package/999_entrypoint.py in the source tree and the installed path is UNPROVEN.

The primary control CLI scripts/core/intake_preflight/factory.py is a held file owned by S75-T13. Its own export closure is reported, not fixed; the 999 entrypoint is the package's own surface, and the reachability clause reports which carriers the control CLI's closure misses rather than claiming it reaches them.
The 999 tree observed at batch/s75-story-first does not yet carry the S75-T15/T16/T17/T28 modules, so the notion and paid-compatibility rows are declared partial/absent rather than met.
